_help: Crew-captain lines shown on every Arcade end screen. The shell picks the most fitting group. {me} = player, {captain} = the crew member talking, {n} = how many, {a} and {b} = the two co-op players. Keep lines short, warm and never shaming.

rewinds: You ran it back {n} times. That's how crews win.
Run it back, then keep going. That's the move, {me}.
{n} rewinds and you kept going. That's crew stuff.
rewind1: You ran it back and kept going. That's how crews win.
chills: That chill was a power move.
You took a breath and came back stronger.
Pausing when it gets hot? Pro move, {me}.
timeouts: Taking a minute is never a waste. You came back ready.
That pause helped. Everyone gets heated sometimes.
spots: You spotted it early. That's a superpower.
Noticing early beats reacting late. You're a spotter, {me}!
You caught {n} sparks before they grew. Crew's got you.
coop: Two players, one beat. Love that, {a} and {b}.
showdown: The Owls said it best: you run it back, you get it.
Sequence by sequence. That's how you beat a boss.
newBest: New best, {me}! Look at you go.
improved: Look at that climb. Progress beats perfection.
default: Nice groove. See you next round!

windDown.title: The crew's cooling down
windDown.text: The Arcade opens again in the morning. Story, closet and the Crew Wall are still open.

cap.title: That's today's Arcade time
cap.text: Your tickets are safe for tomorrow. Story, closet and the Crew Wall are still open!

tickets.title: Earn a ticket in real life
tickets.text: Every real-life point is a ticket. A Rewind is two!

practiceLocked.title: Practice unlocks at 3 points
practiceLocked.text: Earn 3 real-life points today to unlock it.

showdownLocked.title: Showdown opens with the Crew Challenge
showdownLocked.text: Finish this week's Crew Challenge together to call out the Neon Owls!

showdownDone.title: Showdown beaten this week!
showdownDone.text: The Neon Owls want a rematch — finish another Crew Challenge together!
